# LaunchBoards

## Last-checked: 2026-09-14
## Version: 1.2.0

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/SoftwareCenter
Pointer repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/LaunchBoards
Owner: file-bricks
Primary language: Python
Primary UI stack: PySide6 (Qt 6)
License: MIT
Third-Party Licenses: https://github.com/file-bricks/LaunchBoards/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md

## Summary

LaunchBoards is a specialized second branding and dedicated workspace profile of SoftwareCenter. It organizes application shortcuts, utilities, and project directories into tabbed workspace boards ("Launch Boards") with an emphasis on context switching, fast filter search, and drag-and-drop management. It runs on the shared, actively maintained SoftwareCenter codebase using the dedicated `PROFILE_LAUNCHBOARDS` profile.

Discovery positioning: tab-based workspace launcher, local-first shortcut organizer, PySide6 desktop board manager, offline application launchpad, privacy-respecting program launcher.

## Current Scope

- Primary platform: Windows desktop (Windows 10 / 11).
- Technology stack: Python 3.10+, PySide6 (Qt 6).
- Build targets: Portable standalone PyInstaller executables (`LaunchBoards.exe`).
- Non-goals: Cloud shortcut synchronization, background daemon services, shell taskbar replacements, automated internet package downloads.

## Disambiguation

LaunchBoards is a local desktop workspace organizer. It is not:
- An enterprise portal or cloud-synced dashboard
- An application package manager (it does not install or download software)
- A system taskbar or shell replacement
- A separate fork of SoftwareCenter (it is an official product profile sharing the same codebase)

## Target Personas

- **[PERSONA-01] Multi-Project Software Engineers & DevOps Practitioners:** Instant context-switching across project stacks without desktop clutter.
- **[PERSONA-02] Privacy-First Desktop Power Users & Researchers:** Air-gapped and local-first execution with zero cloud telemetry.
- **[PERSONA-03] Creative Directors & Multimedia Producers:** Segregating heavy media creation suites into dedicated boards without RAM overhead.
- **[PERSONA-04] System Administrators & Homelab Operators:** Unprivileged `RunAsInvoker` portable management launcher across workstations.

## Comparative Matrix vs. Alternatives

Evaluated against Windows Start Menu / Taskbar, Microsoft PowerToys Run / Flow Launcher, Stardock Fences, and Cloud Dashboard SaaS across 10 dimensions mapped to `INV-LOCAL-01` through `INV-LOCAL-10`.

## Architecture & Security Invariants

- **INV-LOCAL-01 (Zero Network Egress):** Operates 100% offline with zero outbound network connections, telemetry, or external pings.
- **INV-LOCAL-02 (Unprivileged Run):** Executes strictly in standard user space (`RunAsInvoker`) without administrative (UAC) elevation.
- **INV-LOCAL-03 (Non-Destructive Ops):** Removing shortcuts from a board only removes UI metadata; target files are never modified or removed.
- **INV-LOCAL-04 (Safe Link Resolution):** Safely extracts target metadata from `.lnk` files without executing shell evaluation scripts.
- **INV-LOCAL-05 (Profile Isolation):** Uses dedicated `QSettings` namespace `file-bricks/LaunchBoards` isolated from `file-bricks/SoftwareCenter`.
- **INV-LOCAL-06 (Mutex Independence):** Uses dedicated single-instance lock `LaunchBoards.lock`, enabling simultaneous execution alongside SoftwareCenter.
- **INV-LOCAL-07 (Schema Parity):** Compatible with standard profile schema (`softwarecenter-profile-v1.json`).
- **INV-LOCAL-08 (Canonical Authority):** All core engine code, tests, and CI workflows reside in `file-bricks/SoftwareCenter`.
- **INV-LOCAL-09 (Bilingual Parity):** Complete parity between English and German documentation (`P-006`).
- **INV-LOCAL-10 (Security SLA):** 48-hour response confirmation and 5-day triage commitment.
